name: Lantern of Warding (Example)
author: voodoo573
description: EXAMPLE ITEM. A brass lantern whose steady glow makes its bearer harder to hit. It shows the Magic Item Forge format with a simple mechanical bonus.
summary: Example magic item: uncommon wondrous lantern, +1 AC while held.

data.name: Lantern of Warding (Example)
data.desc: While you hold this lit lantern, you gain a +1 bonus to AC. It sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for a further 20 feet, and burns without oil.
